item.text: I’m taking one more pass at the structure. The file is still doing data modeling, algorithm orchestration, and demo execution in one class, so I’m splitting those responsibilities more cleanly while keeping the same output.

I’ve narrowed the refactor: keep `CuttingRod.cutRod(...)` as the entry point, but move the bottom-up DP state into a dedicated solver object. That makes the top-level method a thin boundary and keeps the recurrence isolated.
The solver extraction is done. I also made `PriceTable` defensively copy its input so the calculation can’t be affected by caller-side mutation after construction.

Refactored [cutting_a_rod.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/047_cutting_a_rod/cutting_a_rod.java:1) again to separate responsibilities more cleanly. `CuttingRod.cutRod(...)` is now just the boundary method, the DP state and recurrence live in `RodCuttingSolver`, and the sentinel-backed input is encapsulated in `PriceTable`.
